name: qiaomu-campus-resume
upstream_inspiration: user-provided computer-science student resume prompt; Matt Pocock/grill-me; Addy Osmani/interview-me; alirezarezvani/grill-me; tw93/kami@fbdb54f59b7f224db55322357e5739b9ef9687f4; mmmlllnnn/ResumeCollection@56a18c26dd8d6ecd60df80b7dd8261b78dd70998 (methods and layout research only)

intent.job_to_be_done: 通过一问一答深挖并确认大学生的求职事实，再生成一份可信、岗位相关、可编辑且经过 PDF 验收的投递简历
inputs: local PDF, DOCX, Markdown or text resume
outputs: interview-ledger.json with confirmed facts, evidence links, uncertainties and confirmation state
one default editable local HTML resume
one default A4 text-based PDF resume
optional explicit multi-theme or ResumeCollection comparison set

qiaomu_defaults.theme: one role-appropriate single-column theme; multi-theme only on explicit request

release_gates: interview readiness assessment with two evidence loops and explicit confirmation
separator-only border and zero-radius HTML check
typography marker, Latin layer, zero px, zero italic and zero link-chip check
